complete_examples.text: Regardless of whether the basement is continuous or has voids, the stress–strain curves of the loose fill specimens exhibit creep and water-softening characteristics.

Under the same support conditions, the load-bearing capacity of the intact basement specimens is significantly higher than that of the loose fill specimens, with less noticeable step and creep phenomena in the curves.
